headline: Approved a letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for their heroic action; approved August minutes and department reports.
summary: Members approved the August 18 meeting minutes and the August department reports. They voted unanimously to send a letter commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for aiding victims after a garbage truck crashed into the Pequabuck River. A property owner at 20-22 Union Street asked for a payment arrangement on a high water and sewer bill and was asked to write a letter.

transcript:
# BOARD OF WATER COMMISSION
## SEPTEMBER 15, 2026 – REGULAR MEETING

**PRESENT:** Chairperson Phelan; Commissioners Ferrier, Porrini and Cunningham. Council Liaison Peter Kelley.

**PRESENT by videoconference:** Superintendent Longo.

**STAFF PRESENT:** Assistant Superintendents Pagliaruli, Bolduc, Keegan, and Dawn LaBella, Office Manager.

**ABSENT:** Commissioner Dunn.

### 1) CALL TO ORDER.

Chairperson Phelan called the meeting of the Board of Water Commission to order at 6:25 p.m.

### 2) PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE.

### 3) MOMENT OF SILENCE.

### 4) APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE AUGUST 18, 2026 REGULAR MEETING.

On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 18, 2026 regular meeting minutes as presented.
Motion passed.

### 5) APPROVAL OF THE DEPARTMENT REPORTS FOR THE MONTH OF AUGUST 2026.

On motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to approve the August 2026 Department Reports as presented.
Motion passed.

### 6) PUBLIC PARTICIPATION.

Owner of 20-22 Union Street asked the Board to consider a payment arrangement on his high water/sewer bill due to a high sewer read based on his winter quarter read. The Board requested that he write a letter requesting as such.

### 7) CUSTOMER CORRESPONDENCE.

None.

### 8) COMMITTEE REPORTS.

None.

### 10) SUPERINTENDENTS REPORT.

No action taken.

### 11) CHAIRPERSONS REPORT.

Chairperson Phelan informed the Board of the heroic action of Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro. Rending aid to the victims that were in the garbage truck when the brakes failed coming down Willis Street and crashed into the Pequabuck River. It was suggested that a letter from the Board commending them for their heroic actions.

On motion of Commissioner Cunningham and seconded; it was unanimously voted to send a letter on behalf of the Board commending Travis Aubin and Rich Ministro for their heroic action.
Motion passed unanimously.

### 12) OLD BUSINESS.

None.

### 13) NEW BUSINESS.

None.

### 14) ADJOURNMENT.

At 7:02 p.m., on motion of Commissioner Porrini and seconded; it was unanimously voted to adjourn.

ATTEST: Renee M. Ratta
Water & Sewer Administrative Assistant
